title: New OpenAI Academy courses for the next era of work
summary: OpenAI introduces three Academy courses that help people build practical AI skills, create repeatable workflows, and apply agents in everyday work.
body: OpenAI introduces three Academy courses that help people build practical AI skills, create repeatable workflows, and apply agents in everyday work.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了三门全新的Academy课程，旨在帮助人们构建实用的AI技能、创建可重复的工作流，并在日常工作中应用智能体。这些课程扩展了OpenAI在企业和个人用户AI普及方面的教育布局。原始信息显示：OpenAI introduces three Academy courses that help people build practical AI skills, create repeatable workflows, and apply agents in everyday work.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“New OpenAI Academy courses for the next era of work”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出了三门新的Academy课程，帮助职场人士构建实用AI技能、工作流和应用智能体。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
